text_block_list.text: One day in February, I head to my office just like usual, when…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Finally. I've been waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: C'mon, you better get eating now or it'll go bad before you can finish it.
I look to where Narita Brian is pointing…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Right? I mean, it's fine if people want to give me chocolates, but I wish they wouldn't do it all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Let's start with the ones closest to their expiration dates.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch! You think I'm going to let you weasel out of your duties?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Here, take a look at this card.
At Narita Brian's insistence, I look at the message card attached to one of the boxes.

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text: "Dear Narita Brian, I want to be just like you! You look so cool when you run!"

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text: "I also want to give my sincerest thanks to your trainer for always supporting you. You two really are the best combo!"

text_block_list.name: Message Card
text_block_list.text: "I hope both of you will accept this chocolate as a token of my appreciation!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This chocolate is for me and you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So, are you ready?
And so, we get started on the mountain of chocolate…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Do we really have to eat chocolate again tomorrow?
choice_data_list: We gotta make sure we eat it all, though.
We gotta make sure we eat it all, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Of course. We can't be disrespectful.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My mom and sister are both very strict about this kind of thing. They told me never to snub a show of kindness.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: By the way…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This one isn't for the both of us. This one is just for you.
I open the package to find three small chocolates I often see in convenience stores.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Make sure you eat them all.
Narita Brian looks somewhat embarrassed as she heads back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Make sure you eat them all.
choice_data_list: What do you want in return?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Nothing. That's not why I gave them to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you do give me something, I'll take it though. Like I said before, that's how I do things.
choice_data_list: I'll be sure to pour my heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Knowing you, there'll be enough heart in it to give me heartburn. No amount of sugar will hide it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And I can't imagine anyone else being able to stomach it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …At least bring me something I like.
A few days later, I give Narita Brian some snacks in return.
